title: Training videos in protocols
items: Training videos attached to protocols — they play offline, right under the text, and remember where you stopped.
Search results mark which protocols have a video and how long it runs.
Sync with the centre server checks the connection before it tries, and says plainly what is wrong.
Signed automatic updates: the app offers the new version and verifies the signature before installing.

title: Forms, shift journals and printing
items: Printable forms and shift journals: fill in on paper, keep the master copy in the base.
Print layout for every material, including tables and diagrams that must fit one page.
Search now reads the text inside attached files, not just titles.
Colour schemes for night shifts and for shared screens in the staff room.

title: The handbook goes offline
items: The whole staff handbook lives on the machine: no network, no waiting, nothing to log into.
Block editor for protocols with checklists, warnings and cross-links between materials.
Full-text search with typo tolerance and keyboard navigation (Ctrl+K).
Export and import of the whole base as one file — backups a night consultant can make alone.
